name: 1.4 PATCH
short_description: Community Mod Framework 2.4.1, Construction Manager 2.2.12 (with personal edits) and Improved Subject Management 1.10.1, merged into one mod and rebased onto vanilla 1.4. The stale 1.3 GUI copies that broke the location window, the estate privilege card and the rename dialog have been regenerated from 1.4. Keeps the id community_mod_framework so any other CMF-dependent mod still resolves. Disable the three Workshop originals before enabling this.
